title: TRICARE Premium-Based Plans: Later-Month Family Relief on Advance-Billed Months
content:
## Rule

When a coverage-type adjustment has been billed on a TRICARE Reserve Select plan for a coverage month later than its most recently paid month, and the purchaser's active duty TRICARE coverage carried days of the period that adjustment covers, the adjustment bill of that latest-billed month owes a later-month family relief for those days, posted against it as an activation-on-orders credit. The paid-bill condition for credits is set aside only for a later-month family relief, which is posted against such a bill although no payment stands against it; every other credit on the plan still needs a payment posted against its bill.

The latest-billed month is the coverage month of the plan's monthly bill with the latest due date; the most recently paid month is the coverage month of the bill that the latest posted premium payment on the plan settles. This relief concerns the TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, TRICARE Reserve Select tiers.

## Account effect

One credit entry with reason activation on orders, tied to the adjustment bill of the latest-billed month, lowering the plan's premium balance by the amount relieved.

## Action reference - `relieve_later_month_family_adjustment_600a6ce9`

**Capability.** The action posts an activation-on-orders credit on a TRICARE Reserve Select plan against the coverage-type adjustment bill of a coverage month billed in advance, later than the most recently paid month, relieving the added family premium for the days of that month on which the purchaser's active duty TRICARE coverage also covered the family; the bill need not carry a payment. One call books one credit entry (reason: activation on orders) tied to the named adjustment bill and coverage month, and lowers the plan's premium balance by the relieved amount.

**How it is invoked.** `relieve_later_month_family_adjustment_600a6ce9` is an agent-side action: unlock it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then call it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `premium_enrollment_id` | reference number of the premium-based plan, as returned by the premium-plan lookup for the purchaser | identifier |
| `related_premium_entry_id` | reference number of the coverage-type adjustment bill the credit is posted against, as returned by the premium-ledger lookup for the plan | identifier |
| `coverage_month` | coverage month of that bill, exactly as the bill shows it | YYYY-MM |
| `coverage_days` | number of days of that month the credit covers | integer from 1 to 31 |
| `amount` | the credit amount in USD, already rounded to the cent; it is booked exactly as given | positive number with 2 decimal places |

**Return.** The receipt is a dictionary rendered as text with `premium_entry_id` (reference number of the new credit entry), `premium_enrollment_id` (the plan), `related_premium_entry_id` (the bill credited), `coverage_month` (YYYY-MM), `coverage_days` (integer), `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places), `adjustment_reason` (always `activation_on_orders`), `premium_balance_due` (the plan's premium balance in USD after the credit; a negative figure means money is owed to the purchaser) and `status` ("posted" once the credit is booked).
